title: Turning tracking off keeps every bin quantity
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-KEEPBINS-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with 4 in {Bin-A} and 3 in {Bin-B}.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  3. Read the Inventory section before saving.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Read the {Part-A} row's Bin Location / Quantity cell.
  6. Click the {Part-A} row and read the Inventory section.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Both bin rows are still shown with their quantities: {Bin-A} 4 and {Bin-B} 3.
  • Step 5: Bin Location / Quantity still reads "{Bin-A} | 4" and "{Bin-B} | 3" (4 + 3 = 7 units still on the shelf; nothing was set to zero).
  • Step 6: The dialog shows the switch off and the same two bins, 4 and 3.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S5-R3, S5-R3a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.2 (Switch off) and tracking-note-1, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R3: “Turning tracking off hides Min and Max in the part dialog. It does not change the quantity in any bin.”
  • S5-R3a: “The bin locations and their quantities stay visible in the part dialog, as a shelf reference (S4-R6).”
